{'id': 0, 'text': "Any loyal reader knows 9to5Toys' affinity for the Nomad brand. The company has been putting out some of the best iPhone cases on the market for years, and that's no different this year with the all-new iPhone 18 Pro series. That said, new devices rarely get discounted in the first few months on the market, unless you use our exclusive Nomad promo code. Enter '9TO5MAC' at checkout to take 15% off any of its new iPhone 18 Pro cases."}

{'id': 11, 'text': 'Speaking of which, you can also save 20% on a screen protector with most Nomad cases when added to the same cart at checkout.'}

{'id': 12, 'text': "Personally, I'm a big fan of Nomad's Traditional leather case with the leather wrapping around the side, but the two-tone Modern leather version looks great too. I also got my hands on this year's limited-edition burgundy colorway to match the same-colored iPhone 18 Pro, and it looks as great as always."}

{'id': 13, 'text': 'The brand is also rolling out a brand-new Rugged case this year with a Baja, California-inspired topographical design that honestly looks even better in person than it does on the website:'}

{'id': 14, 'text': "And for a closer look at the entire 2026 Nomad iPhone 18 Pro lineup, be sure to check out our full hands-on coverage and don't forget to bring the discount code above with you."}
